theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (v : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (δ K : ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → 0 ≤ δ → (∀ k, Continuous (v k)) → (∀ k, ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |v k x - v k y| ≤ K) → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |v k x - u x|) atTop (𝓝 0) → ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |u x - u y| ≤ K
